active_mount_safety: No direct target-case writable/read-only mount or open FD was present. During the second operation one active I4F solver had its own separate bundle RW and broad results/runs RO mount; the helper permits only that exact RO ancestor after per-file lsof checks. All archived files are outside its own bundle.
metadata_restoration_limitations: POSIX ctime cannot be set by the restore helper; the original ctime_ns remains recorded per member.
Original parent-directory metadata is stored in source_parent_directories_metadata. Restore the entire tree first, then restore directory mode/owner/times if exact directory metadata is required.

restore_example.no_overwrite: The helper refuses existing files, symlinked destination components, unsafe relative paths, archive hash mismatches, and decompressed byte/hash mismatches.
